title: A free community catalog for game developers (including vibecoders)
author: BlazeEcho
selftext:
[https://catalog.hearthengine.com/](https://catalog.hearthengine.com/)

You can upload a browser build, or just link out to your itch page, Steam page, or wherever the game already lives (for free ofc). You also have your own profile people can follow/track.

I felt like there wasn't really a fleshed out platform for us to post our \[vibecoded\] games on and get some players so here we are. It's super sparse right now but every new user will build the community, and I want to expand into giving away different resources and tools here in the future. Any feedback would be appreciated.
